bendHint: How far the row turns from its first seat to its last. Negative bends the other way.
sidesHint: Seats on each side, {{count}} in all. A change takes the seats from the middle or the other arm.
pathHint: The seats follow the path's points; they start as an L.
align: Line up with the other rows
firstGap: The first row has no space above it: move the block instead.
reverse: Number this row the other way
gapHandle: Drag to change the space above {{name}}
planHint: Double-click a row on the plan to pick it; drag the bar between two rows to change the space.
armHandle: Drag to change side {{arm}} of row {{name}}
pointHandle: Point {{n}} of row {{name}}: drag to move, double-click to take out
addPoint: Add a point to row {{name}} here
shapeHint: On the plan: drag the handles to bend the row, change a side or move the path's points. + adds a point; double-click a point takes it out.
